description: Labelled TPMS option documents. `schema` is the verdict of spec/dry-tpms-options-v1.schema.json; `engine` is the verdict of dry_core::try_tpms_ops after serde_json deserialization. tools/validate_reports.py checks the schema column without dry-core; crates/core/tests/tpms_options_schema.rs checks the engine column and the quoted refusal text. Both tools also enforce the invariant that binds them: no case may be schema-invalid and engine-accepted, i.e. the schema never refuses a bundle the engine would run.

cases.note: An empty bundle takes every documented default.
The smallest legal block: one cell per axis at the minimum sample rate.
serde reads an explicit null for an Option field as 'absent', so null means the documented default.
The engine does not set deny_unknown_fields, so unknown keys — including a mis-cased real option — are silently ignored. The schema matches that rather than refusing input the engine accepts.
samplesPerCell is accepted at its documented floor of 4.
0 is the documented 'unlimited' sentinel that sdk/ts encodes Infinity as; JSON has no Infinity literal.

-0.0 is not < 0.0, so the negativity guard lets it through and the budget then reads it as the unlimited sentinel. JSON Schema's minimum:0 agrees. Pinned because a negative-looking literal disabling the guardrail is surprising.
16 is the inclusive maximum bisection depth.

MEASURED: the depth cap lives inside `if adaptive_on`, so 17 is accepted when adaptive is off. The schema applies maximum:16 only under the same condition, or it would refuse input the engine accepts.
A zero inset leaves the full block rectangle, which clears the 1e-6 mm collapse gate.
cellSize must be strictly positive.
cellSize must be strictly positive.
layerHeight must be strictly positive.
beadWidth must be strictly positive.
beadHeight must be strictly positive.
nozzleTemp must be strictly positive.
printSpeed must be strictly positive.
flow must be strictly positive.
z0 must be zero or greater.
perimeterInset must be zero or greater. perimeterInset is checked even when perimeter is off.
minPathLength must be zero or greater.

cases.refusal: maxFieldSamples -1 must not be negative or NaN (use 0 for unlimited)
cases.note: maxFieldSamples must be zero or greater.
cellsX must be at least one unit cell.
cellsY must be at least one unit cell.
cellsZ must be at least one unit cell.
Marching squares needs at least 4 samples per cell.
adaptiveMinLayerHeight must be strictly positive, and is only read (and only checked) when adaptive is true.
adaptiveMaxLayerHeight must be strictly positive, and is only read (and only checked) when adaptive is true.
adaptiveMaxLengthDelta must be strictly positive, and is only read (and only checked) when adaptive is true.
adaptiveMaxPointDelta must be strictly positive, and is only read (and only checked) when adaptive is true.
Refinement bisects, so depth is an exponent; 16 is the inclusive cap.
An unknown surface name is a deserialization error, reported as a structured failure by every binding.
cellsX is a u32; a negative literal fails to deserialize before the >= 1 check runs.
A wrong JSON type is a deserialization error in the engine and a type violation in the schema.

cases.refusal: invalid type: string "true", expected a boolean
cases.note: A string is not a boolean on either side.
The field-sample estimate is derived from cells, samplesPerCell, cellSize and layerHeight. JSON Schema cannot compute it, so every option here is individually in domain.
A cross-field comparison, and a tolerance-bearing one (the engine allows a 1e-9 slack). JSON Schema expresses neither.
Whether an inset survives depends on cellSize and the cell counts, and the gate is against the 1e-6 mm emission grid.
Vacuity: the iso level lies outside the field's range, so nothing is traced. Depends on the surface's actual value range.
Vacuity: a filter longer than every stitched contour empties the program. Depends on the traced geometry.

cases.refusal: invalid type: floating point `2.0`, expected u32
cases.note: JSON Schema counts 2.0 as an integer; serde_json refuses any float spelling for a u32. The schema over-accepts here, which is the safe direction.
